events.title: Clogwork is participating in Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Steam Next FestLet's just hope that more people see this game and test the demo. Like always, more feedback is always welcomed.Controller supportController support has been improved. If you use controller please give me feedback here.Workshop (full game)Clogwork's full version now can handle custom figures made by players, and custom puzzles for the campaign. If you're thinking of good ideas that would be fun in the campaign, just make it and other people will play them.

events.title: Major update: Campaign mode and others
events.summary: Clogwork just had a big update.Your voices have been heard, and the main thing players complained about was that the tutorial was terrible. People felt overwhelmed by all the choices at the start of the game and the tutorial didn't really do a good job at explaining it. So Clogwork now has a campaign mode. events.title: Free CLOGWORK Demo is out now.
events.summary: The demo is finally out. Go download it, build your factory, and if you enjoyed the demo, please add the full game to your wishlist. Adding it to your wishlist will notify you when the release is out or about other events. There is no time limit in this demo, and your objective is to build and deliver 3 target figures.A simple bar to get you started.A little chair.A house (this one will take you longer).Feedback Please drop your demo feedback in this community post.
